question.text: Which of the following must be disclosed in the PPM regarding the management team of an AIF as per SEBI requirements?

answer.text: Only the name of the Chief Investment Officer
Personal financial statements of all team members
Background, experience, and track record of key investment team members, including key persons identified under the Key Person Clause
The educational qualifications of the administrative staff

explanation.text: The Logic: PPM review and audit material lists particulars of the investment management team and their credentials, and PPM audit checks cover the role of the key investment team or investment committee. Disclosure focused on the key investment team supports investors' assessment of who actually runs the fund. The Trap: Option A is too narrow — it captures only one role. Option B (personal financial statements) and Option D (administrative-staff qualifications) are not part of the PPM disclosure framework for the management team. Note: Detailed personal track-record and Key Person Clause specifics depend on the particular PPM template; the source mandates disclosure around investment team particulars and credentials.
